_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Test and Inspection Plan (TIP)
summary: The Test and Inspection Plan identifies all inspections and tests required by referenced documents and Work Items, plus any additional tests the contractor deems necessary to confirm product conformance.
use_relationship:
This DID is used to identify all inspections and tests required by zero-tier references and first tier references, as well as symbols (I)(V)(Q) test/inspections and (G) government notification identified in the Work Item, and any additional tests and inspections the contractor deems necessary to substantiate product conformance.
This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The TIP shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The TIP shall include the following information: Ship's name/hull number; Work Item number; Work Item Paragraph number; Identification of item/component to be inspected/tested; Standard Item Number; Standard Item Paragraph; Location; Sub-Contractor (if applicable); Inspection Symbol (I, V, Q, G); Accept/Reject Criteria; Test Result (Accept or Reject); Notify Date; Notify Time; Request Date; Request Time; Inspection Date; Name of Person Notified; Name of Government Representative at Inspection; Name of Contractor's authorized representative who witnessed/performed test.
